applicabilityBasis.summary: USDU is a transferable U.S.-dollar-denominated fiat-referenced token with professional-client par USD redemption; domestic UAE payment use is restricted.

genius.notes: ADGM FSP250089 confirms local fiat-referenced-token issuance only. It does not establish GENIUS authorization or a U.S. foreign-issuer exception. The issuer whitepaper describes UAE foreign-payment-token registration, which remains issuer-attributed. USDU is transferable for settlement and professional clients can redeem at par through Aquanow after onboarding, normally within two business days. Crowe has public monthly reserve examinations, including August 2026; these are reserve assurance, not GENIUS approval. No public U.S. approval, application or GENIUS pathway intent was found in the dated review. MiCA territorial assessment is separate.

sourcesChecked: OCC Bulletin 2026-3 and raw public digital-asset pending-applicant table

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No reviewed source identifies this token or its established legal issuer as a GENIUS permitted payment stablecoin issuer, state-qualified issuer, official applicant, or federally registered foreign issuer; no token-specific GENIUS pathway announcement or U.S. enforcement action was located. This is a dated, bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no private application or regulatory engagement exists. Non-U.S. licenses, bank or trust charters, reserve assurances and proposed rules do not establish GENIUS authorization.
